case.summary: Case HHG-004 has been evaluated with a fraud verdict at a calibrated probability of 0.97, following the card-not-present new device pattern. The risk assessment was elevated by online channel activity, a high-risk model score in decile 9/10, prior confirmed fraud history on both this card and the customer's other cards, and an anomalous transaction amount. Additionally, the customer explicitly denied making the transaction. Similar confirmed fraud precedents in the network feature parallel card-not-present fraud characteristics involving unrecognized activity on new devices. In response to these findings, the policy engine has executed automated safeguards including blocking the card, creating a formal case, filing a report, and monitoring connected cards.

sar.narrative: Suspicious activity involving unauthorized card-not-present transactions was identified on the account under Case ID HHG-004, resulting in a financial exposure of $128.33. The fraudulent activity was conducted online utilizing a new and previously unrecognized device running Firefox 47.0. Risk analysis indicated that the transaction originated from a device family shared across multiple other cards, and the customer explicitly denied making the purchase. Furthermore, historical data revealed prior confirmed fraud cases associated with both this specific card tuple and the customer on different cards. The transaction amount deviated significantly from the card's typical spending patterns, elevating the risk score into the upper decile. Following customer contact and verification, the fraudulent nature of the transaction was established, and the verdict was finalized as fraud.
